title: Absolutism
description: This is my first mod made on MCreactor. I took the idea for it from the avarita mod. This mod also adds 26 new items, 1 new structure with new loot and 19 achievements. These achievements will help you in learning the mod.
body:
Step into a new dimension of power with mod Absolutia! This mod introduces a brand-new tier of endgame gear and mysterious consumables, pushing your survival experience beyond its limits.

✨ New Items & Features:

Absolute Armor – A truly impenetrable set of armor. Become virtually unkillable and laugh in the face of dragons, withers, and anything else that dares to strike you.

Absolute Star – A legendary crafting component, forged from the rarest materials in the universe. Required to create the most powerful tools and armor.

Universal drink – A mysterious brew crafted from dragon's breath. Used as an advanced crafting component, not for drinking!

Dragon's Chewing Gum – Yes, you read that right. Crafted from the Universal Potion. Despite the name, you cannot eat it – it's an important crafting ingredient.

Chaos core – A mysterious, sphere of an interdimensional structure. Used in high-tier crafting recipes.

Absolutium Tools & Weapons – Mine faster, fight harder, and build greater with tools forged from Absolutium Ingots. These unbreakable (or nearly unbreakable) implements will change the way you play.

Absolutium Ingots – The foundation of it all. Smelt, craft, and forge these ingots to create the ultimate gear.

🛠️ New Crafting Mechanics:

Absolute Workbench – A brand new crafting table where all Absolutia-tier items are crafted. All recipes for weapons, tools, and armor are made here in the familiar way, but using Absolutium Ingots and Absolute Rods of the Nether as base materials.

🌍 Language Support:

The mod is fully translated into English and Russian – enjoy the game in your preferred language without any barriers.

🎮 Why download this mod?

Perfect for players who want to feel truly overpowered in the late game.

Adds a sense of mystery with unique consumables like Dragon’s Chewing Gum and the Universal drink.

Fully compatible with most other mods (please report any issues).

⚙️ Requirements: Forge

📌 Recommended for: Players who love exploration, collecting rare materials, and achieving absolute power.
